entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE in EMM-DEREGISTERED state to attach to the network. UE sends ATTACH REQUEST message, starts timer T3410, and enters EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Initial message of attach procedure sent from UE to MME. Contains various information elements including EPS mobile identity, UE network capability, and optional ESM message container.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: Initial state where UE is not registered with the network. Attach procedure is initiated from this state.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by UE after sending ATTACH REQUEST message and starting timer T3410.

entities.name: T3410
entities.description: Timer started when UE sends ATTACH REQUEST message. Monitors the attach procedure completion.

entities.name: T3402
entities.description: Timer that may be running when attach procedure is initiated. UE stops this timer if running.

entities.name: T3411
entities.description: Timer that may be running when attach procedure is initiated. UE stops this timer if running.

entities.name: EPS mobile identity
entities.description: IE in ATTACH REQUEST message containing UE identity (IMSI, GUTI, mapped GUTI, or IMEI) depending on various conditions.

entities.name: UE network capability
entities.description: IE in ATTACH REQUEST message indicating UE's supported features and capabilities through various capability bits.

entities.name: ESM message container
entities.description: IE in ATTACH REQUEST message containing either PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST or ESM DUMMY MESSAGE depending on PDN connection requirements.

entities.name: PLMN selection condition
entities.description: Condition determining which identity to include in EPS mobile identity IE based on whether selected PLMN is registered PLMN or equivalent PLMN.

entities.name: Interworking without N26 interface condition
entities.description: Condition determining identity mapping and security context usage during inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode.

entities.name: Stop running timers
entities.description: UE behavior to stop timers T3402 and T3411 if they are currently running when initiating attach procedure.

relations.description: Attach procedure includes sending ATTACH REQUEST message as initial step
Attach procedure is initiated when UE is in EMM-DEREGISTERED state
Attach procedure causes UE to enter EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state

ATTACH REQUEST message contains UE network capability IE
ATTACH REQUEST message contains ESM message container IE

Content of EPS mobile identity IE is determined by interworking without N26 interface conditions
